11532 SE 173rd St #53 in Renton has two bedrooms, one and a half baths and 1,132 square feet. The living room sliders open to a private patio that backs to the woods, and the garage has a workbench and room for storage.

The community has a pool, a clubhouse with a kitchen and a sauna, and a sport court.

Want to see it in person? Send me a message and I’ll set up a private showing. Every photo is at homes.ranchpnw.com/11532.
